issues.explanation: The dark blue text of the 'Templates' item in the main navigation bar fails contrast requirements against the black background, making primary navigation hard to read.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the text color to white (#FFFFFF) or a bright highlight blue to ensure at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the black background.

issues.explanation: The dark blue button text on the 'Use Templates' buttons inside each card lacks sufficient visual contrast against the vibrant blue button fill, impairing readability of card action labels.
issues.suggested_fix: Set the text color to crisp white (#FFFFFF) on top of the blue button to satisfy contrast guidelines.

issues.explanation: The bottom CTA area displays two competing button styles with a dark 'Generate Free Diaram' button alongside a outlined blue 'View Templates' button on a bright blue background, creating confusion about the primary task.
issues.location_in_image: Bottom banner action buttons ('Generate Free Diaram' and 'View Templates')
issues.suggested_fix: Establish a clear visual priority by styling the main action button in high-contrast solid white with dark text, while styling the secondary button as a clear subtle outline or link style.

issues.explanation: The low-contrast dim gray description text inside each card container is difficult to read against the dark gray card surface.
issues.location_in_image: Card description text ('Complete auth flow with')
issues.suggested_fix: Increase the lightness of the description text to a light gray (#D0D0D0 or lighter) to achieve a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.
